excluded_main_results: 2023-2024: used for method development; retained only in historical appendix
status: Retrospective test of a candidate revisited after prior results; data previously accessed. Not untouched confirmatory evidence. All intervals and cost levels reported, no checkpoint selection. Combined test carries holdings continuously; separate intervals start independently from cash.
buy_hold: Equal initial weights, plus hold-first-trained-target and hold-first-untrained-target controls; each initial purchase fee charged; no terminal liquidation
bootstrap: Paired circular blocks of5/20/60 sessions,5000 replicates; CI conditional on selected candidate, not adjusted for historical search; three seeds do not create three independent markets
